newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Evans sees higher first half profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Evans sees higher first half profit.

text.p: Heavy engineer Evans Deakin Industries Ltd said on Monday that operating profit in the first six months ending December 31 would rise to an estimated A$9.0 million from A$6.053 million a year earlier.
The company, which acquired Sydney engineer Clyde Industries Ltd earlier this year for A$180 million, said its half year accounts would be finalised in February 1997.

Evans Deakin chairman Ron Paul said there was strong investor interest in the enlarged company since the takeover was completed two months ago and work was continuing on the sale of the remainder of Clyde's non-core Ajax chemicals business.
Paul said the company's order book stood at about A$500 million.

"The major task ahead in the near future is to recover the depleted order book position which existed in some of the Clyde divisions and rebuild those operations into a significant force in the Australian and international marketplace," he said.
